name: @stillfail/station
description: The still.fail station in TypeScript (docs/station-ts.md); its native parts in native/

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/read/worker.ts --outbase=src --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --external:*.node --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && mkdir -p dist/skills && cp ../mesh/app/src/skills/*.md dist/skills/
